_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
The original recording is retained, and failed durable acceptance is retried. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". Recording uploads (POST /api/upload/raw) answer with the path /tmp/shelley-uploads/preserved.webm, and call "uploads" counts them. The first message submission (POST /api/conversation/<id>/chat) fails with "transcription unavailable"; later ones are accepted without being sent on. Call "submissions" reports them as "<count> <same|different>": "same" when every one has the same URL and body as the first. The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new. Fill the message input with "Keep this draft". Click the voice button.
2. [data-testid="recording-status"] should have the text exactly "Recording…". Click the stop button.
3. [data-testid="recording-retained"] should become visible, [data-testid="recording-preserved-text"] should have the text exactly "Keep this draft", and no [data-testid="transcription-task"] may exist (count 0).
4. Click the retry button. No recording panel should remain (count 0), and the message input should have the value "" (empty).
5. Call "uploads" must return "1", call "submissions" must return "2 same", and window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts must be 1.
